etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English lawemaker, lawe maker, equivalent to law +‎ maker.

definitions.definition: One who makes or enacts laws.

quote.citation: 2021 April 21, “French to favour rail over short-haul flights”, in RAIL, number 929, page 11:
quote.text: Lawmakers in France voted over the weekend of April 10/11 to introduce measures to restrict flights on routes where the same journey can be made by rail in under two and a half hours.
